# #2731: Patch: drop the Owned list from the Collection's Cosmetics section
Opened by @MaxGoetzmann.

## What it does

`/collection?section=cosmetics` shows an **Equipped** section (the account tiles, `AccountCosmeticTiles.tsx`) followed by an **Owned** section: a plain text list of every cosmetic the account owns, one row per cosmetic and one per card for per-card ones (`CosmeticsPanel.tsx`, rendered by `CosmeticsSection` in `apps/web/src/routes/collection.tsx`). An account that has opened a few packs gets a list far too long to be useful. The tiles already show what is owned (locked versus unlocked), and per-card cosmetics are picked on the card in the Cards section (R1655000), so the list is redundant. Remove it.

Scope (client only, no server or engine change):

- `apps/web/src/routes/collection.tsx`: drop the `<Section part="cosmetics" title={t("Owned")} …>` and the `useRead(token, getOwnedCosmetics, keptOwned)` it needs, plus `keptOwned` and the `getOwnedCosmetics` import if nothing else there uses them. Keep `GET /api/cosmetics` itself: `AccountCosmeticTiles`, `ownedFullArt.ts`, the deck builder and the shop still read it.
- Delete `apps/web/src/collection/CosmeticsPanel.tsx`. In `collection.ts`, remove `ownedCosmetics` and `collectionTestid.ownedCosmetic`, and remove `cardNameOf` only if nothing still uses it. `CosmeticPacks.tsx` uses it, so it probably stays.
- Remove any strings left unused in the i18n catalogs (`"Owned"` is still used by `CardCosmeticsView.tsx`, so keep it; check `"Loading your cosmetics…"`).
- Tests: remove or rewrite the tests of the list in `apps/web/src/collection/collection.test.tsx` (the `OwnedCosmetics` renders, `R1579000 ownedCosmetics lists…`, `R1827000 ownedCosmetics lists owned portraits…`), in `apps/web/src/routes/collection.test.tsx` (the `T.ownedCosmetic` assertions and the `getOwnedCosmetics` call-count expectations that came from the list), and in `e2e/cypress/component/collection-screen.cy.tsx` (line ~134). Do not leave a ruling without a proving test: keep or add tests so R1579000 and R1827000 still have one in each file their `proven_in` lists, or remove a file from `proven_in` when it no longer proves the ruling.
- Spec: R1579000's **The owned list** paragraph and R1827000's sentence "The Collection's owned cosmetics (R1579000) list the portraits the account owns…" describe the list. Add a new ruling note, `spec/rulings/R2731000.md` (this issue's block), with its §11 paragraph in `spec/pending/2731.md`, that amends both, and update those two notes so they point to it (CLAUDE.md rule 3; `docs/issues-and-patches.md`, Ruling numbers).

## Acceptance

- `/collection?section=cosmetics` shows the Equipped heading, its text and the account tiles, and no Owned section or list. A test titled with `R2731000` checks that no `collection-list` or owned-cosmetic row renders there.
- `cargo jackioh spec check` passes.
- No dead exports are left behind (`CosmeticsPanel.tsx` and `ownedCosmetics` are gone). `pnpm --dir apps/web typecheck`, `pnpm --dir apps/web test`, `pnpm exec eslint apps/web e2e` and the collection component spec pass.

## Blocked by, part of

None.
